summary: This video demonstrates an updated Thunderbolt team composition against the Fire Fortress Elemental Guardians in Crown Contest. The team scored over 7.14 billion damage, reaching S+ rank. Perkunte serves as the primary damage dealer, accounting for over 76% of total team output. Stat recommendations emphasize full Enlightenment for Perkunte and Alaura, Accuracy for Tariz and Sha'nachtan, and HP with Accuracy for Maashtur.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Build full Enlightenment and Attack to maximize damage output (dealt over 76% of total team damage).

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Build full HP and some Accuracy.

teams.note: Achieved 7,148,762,656 damage (S+ rank) against Level 270 Elemental Guardians.

tips: Focus on high Enlightenment and Attack on Perkunte to maximize damage in Thunderbolt compositions.
Equip Alaura with full Enlightenment to boost team performance.
Ensure debuffers like Tariz and Sha'nachtan have enough Accuracy for boss encounters.
title: Thunderbolt Team (UPDATED) vs Fire Guardians | Crown Contest | Dragonheir | Season 8
